titulo: Phone face down before the food comes
caption:
Phone face down before the food comes

My friend puts her phone face down before the food even comes. Then I did it too.

Research on conversations has found that a phone merely sitting on the table lowered how close people felt to each other.

For whoever waits for the other phone to go down first.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a royal blue one on the right, each looking down at a phone standing on the table, both buzzing. The blue one looks up, and its phone lies face down with a small pulse. The black one looks over with wide eyes, then lays its own phone face down, and a bubble says me too. Both end with happy eyes and a pulse. The text stays: my friend putting their phone down first. The last card: Choose friction.
